channel.title: RateLog — Cline changelog
channel.description: Every pricing and usage-limit change RateLog has caught for Cline, dated and sourced — no other tools mixed in.

item.title: Cline — Teams tier removed from pricing page
item.description: [↓ reduced] The self-serve Teams tier ("free for 10 users, then $20/user/month," introduced Oct 2025) no longer appears on the live pricing page, which now shows only Open Source and Enterprise. No official removal announcement found — noting the date we confirmed it gone, not necessarily when it happened.

item.title: Cline — Launched ClinePass
item.description: [changed] Cline's first-ever direct paid subscription ($9.99/mo) for curated, discounted open-weight-model access — layered on top of the still-free, still-BYOK core product.

item.title: Cline — First paid organizational tiers
item.description: [changed] Introduced Teams and Enterprise tiers after previously having no paid tier of any kind beyond BYOK inference costs.
